en.headline: Hong Kong to pulp all recovered waste paper locally from 1 October
en.dek: The EcoPark facility in Tuen Mun will handle the city’s full volume, expanding accepted types beyond cardboard, newspapers and office paper to include mixed paper.
body: Hong Kong will pulp all recovered waste paper locally at the EcoPark facility in Tuen Mun from 1 October, ending reliance on exports, the Environmental Protection Department said.

The modernised paper-pulping plant began operating on 27 July and has been ramping up capacity. It can process up to 720,000 tonnes a year, enough for the city’s entire recovered volume, which is expected to rise from more than 500,000 tonnes.

Accepted paper types will expand from the traditional three categories—cardboard, newspapers and office paper—to include mixed paper such as paper bags, packaging boxes and wrapping paper. The department said the change marks a shift toward local waste-to-resources processing and supports the circular economy.

zh.headline: 回收廢紙10月1日起全面本地製漿
zh.dek: 屯門環保園設施處理全港廢紙，可回收種類擴至紙袋、包裝盒及包裝紙，推動循環經濟。
body: 環境保護署表示，香港回收的廢紙將由10月1日起在屯門環保園現代化紙漿生產設施全面本地製漿，不再依賴出口。
該設施於7月27日啟用並逐步提升處理量，年處理能力可達72萬公噸，足以處理全港回收廢紙，預計回收量由每年50多萬公噸逐步提升。
可回收廢紙種類由傳統「三紙」（紙皮、報紙及辦公室用紙）擴至雜紙，包括紙袋、包裝盒及包裝紙。署方指此舉標誌廢紙回收升級至本地資源化，推動循環經濟發展。
